description: Cross-language contract for credential resolution precedence (US4, FR-019/FR-020, CC-005, ADR 0005). Precedence: injected credential > primary (Entra ID) > API-key / connection-string fallback > NoCredentialAvailable. Modeled at the observable-behavior level with fakes; no live Azure. 'primary_available' models whether the Entra ID primary path resolves: the harness maps false to a credential factory that raises (real unavailability, NOT a missing package) and true to a factory that returns the primary. 'probe_fails' opts into runtime failover, mapped to a token_probe that raises so an available primary that cannot acquire a token still falls back. 'env' supplies fallback configuration.

cases.description: An explicitly injected credential takes precedence over both the primary path and any fallback.
When the primary path is available it takes precedence over a configured fallback.
The primary path is unavailable (its factory fails, not merely a missing package) and an API key is configured: resolution falls back to the API key and the operation can proceed.
The primary path is unavailable and both fallbacks are configured: the API key is chosen before the connection string (deterministic fallback order).
The primary path is unavailable and only a connection string is configured: resolution falls back to the connection string.
The primary path is available but its token probe fails (runtime failover opted in): resolution falls back to the configured API key.
The primary path is unavailable and no fallback is configured: resolution raises NoCredentialAvailable.
